resources.string: Works only while a Monolith focus session is running: it enforces nothing, and keeps nothing, when no session is running. During a session it detects launches of apps you blocked and presents the Intention Airlock screen. To enforce your own rules it also reads limited on-screen content in three places: YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels screens, your browser\'s address bar (never while you are typing in it), and system Settings, installer, or app-store screens showing Monolith, so the app cannot be force-stopped or uninstalled mid-session. Nothing is collected outside a session and nothing ever leaves your device.
Displays real-time monotonic focus timer and active app shield telemetry.
